fix_commit_message:
avformat/wavdec: Fix overflow of intermediate in block_align check

Fixes: signed integer overflow: -251517880 * 32 cannot be represented in type 'int'
Fixes: 385224934/clusterfuzz-testcase-minimized-ffmpeg_dem_W64_fuzzer-4909298151915520

Found-by: continuous fuzzing process https://github.com/google/oss-fuzz/tree/master/projects/ffmpeg
Signed-off-by: Michael Niedermayer <michael@niedermayer.cc>
agent_reasoning: The bug-introducing commit added a heuristic to correct broken block_align values in W64 files by computing a minimum expected block_align from bits_per_coded_sample and channel count, using 32-bit int arithmetic. Both operands are attacker-controlled, so the multiplication can overflow a signed int (UB), as found by OSS-Fuzz. The fix commit widens the intermediate computation to 64-bit by declaring the local `block_align` variable as `int64_t` and using a `7LL` literal to force 64-bit division/multiplication. I applied the equivalent minimal edit directly to the corresponding lines in the worktree's w64_read_header function (which lacks the unrelated FF_SANE_NB_CHANNELS condition present in the fix's context, since that's not part of this bug's introduction), preserving the rest of the logic unchanged.
